THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
092
Behind the image
63 / Polka Cable
REFERENCE 5840.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 046
Art direction: Tonal sand, rose and taupe, layered textures, soft muted studio light.
Photorealistic vertical three-quarter fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with
long, wavy honey-brown hair, a small decorative hair clip, a soft pink blush and a calm direct gaze.
She wears a beige long-sleeve shirt with small black polka dots and a long self-tie neck bow,
layered under a rose-taupe cable-knit corset-style vest, a pleated taupe knit mini skirt with a
crochet lace trim, and holds a dark brown leather tote bag. Plain warm sand-colored studio wall
with a pale baseboard, soft diffused light, muted beige, rose and taupe palette, delicate vintage
romance, no text or logos.
64 / Forest Tweed
REFERENCE 5839.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 047
Art direction: Olive, chocolate and blush pink on pure white, rich textures, full-length framing.
Full-length vertical fashion lookbook photograph of an original adult woman with long, wavy
copper-red hair, fair freckled skin, a calm neutral gaze and soft natural makeup, standing straight
on a white seamless studio floor. She wears a cropped dark olive tweed jacket with a flap pocket
and bronze buttons over a white ruched halter top with thin crossed straps, a matching olive
tweed mini skirt with a deep brown faux-fur hem, tall brown leather western-style boots with
stitched detail, and carries a small pink and brown leather shoulder bag with a heart-shaped zip
pocket. Bright even studio light, olive, chocolate and blush palette, rich tweed and fur texture, no
text or logos.
